body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 193f6304b2f55e733f4a56003f0572d45cbe3040 -->
**Needs changes before merge** (one requested change: the test #1233 asks for is missing). The tool itself looks right.

**What looks good**
- `set_setup_post` (`crates/app/src/mcp/setup_tools.rs:178`) runs the same `SetSetupPost` the Setup pane uses, through the session History: one undo step, on the named setup only (`setup` defaults to the active one, like `set_work_offset`).
- "Follow the document" is `post: null`. Unknown posts, unknown setups and "already that post" are refused by the command with plain text. A missing, empty or non-string `post` is refused at the tool. No unwrap/expect/panic in the diff.
- `get_job` setups now show `post` (own or null) and `posts_with` (effective), which makes the pick readable.
- Files are under 400 lines (`setup_tools.rs` 343). Decision file is present, the body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #1233`.

**Local results** (trial-merged with current origin/main, clean merge, camcraft-app)
- `mcp_setup` 8 passed (includes the new `set_setup_post_sets_clears_undoes_and_refuses`); `mcp_setup_mount_trace` 1; `setup_mounts_post` 7 (1 ignored); `setup_mount_trace` 6; `mcp` 18: all pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Requested before merge**
1. Issue #1233's "Done means" says: "an MCP test posts two setups through two dialects (one file per mount, each its own post's markers) and undoes the pick". The new test covers set/clear/undo/redo/refusals through `get_job` read-back only; nothing posts. Add that leg (natural home: `crates/app/tests/mcp_setup_mount_trace.rs`, which today covers only the machine pick): give two setups two different posts with `set_setup_post`, post, assert each mount's file carries its own post's markers, then `undo` the pick and assert the mount follows the document's post again.
2. Machine-kind behaviour is stated (tool description and PR body: "sets the field only, posting judges it") but not tested. Since main now refuses a milling post on a lathe setup at post time (#1213), add one assertion: a post that does not serve the setup's machine kind is accepted by `set_setup_post` and the later post call refuses it by name. Folding it into the test from item 1 is fine.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The camcraft-mcp skill row is deliberately left out (it is a process file; adding it would need a `PROCESS_VERSION` bump, main is at 31). The issue asks for that row too, so please name the follow-up issue in the PR body ("MCP: skill row for set_setup_post"); today it says only "a process PR". If you prefer, add the row here and bump `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.
- `.cps` suffix is how a file post is told from a built-in name; the description says so, fine.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand (a `feat`: at the next cut).
